author: sethmlarson.dev.web.brid.gy
context:
Gaming’s all-digital future doesn’t include “Sonic the Hedgehog 3” and “Pikmin 2” Sony announced that all games from 2028 and onwards would be digital-only. It seems likely that Xbox will follow and that Nintendo will continue making “physical” releases for first-party games during the Switch 2 generation.

In the all-digital gaming future, every game platform will be subject to the same problems and constraints as media streaming services like Netflix and Spotify. We can see hints of how this will affect future games and creative freedom in the medium by looking at re-releases of older games, in particular: Sonic the Hedgehog 3 and Pikmin 2.

* * *

The core problem is that digital games are licenses, which forces an ongoing relationship between you and the owner of the media. And because there’s an ongoing relationship with you, any ongoing licensing relationships that the media owner has _also affect you and your games_. If a license for any media that is part of the game expires or is affected, then the developer must take action to remediate the “issue” in the game.

author: english.pravda.ru.web.brid.gy
context:
London's new African cinema: Cultural hub or voluntary segregation? London has welcomed the inauguration of its first cinema dedicated to African cinema and films by Black directors, a venture that has sparked debate about cultural diversity versus voluntary segregation. The opening ceremony was attended by the British capital's Mayor, Sadiq Khan, prompting a critical examination of whether such specialized spaces foster societal cohesion or reinforce divisions along cultural and ethnic lines.
A Hub for African Culture in the Heart of London

The establishment, known as EbonyLife Place London, was founded by Nigerian entrepreneur Mo Abudu. According to AFP, the complex is more than just a cinema; it boasts a 160-seat auditorium, a Nigerian restaurant, a bar, an art gallery, and a boutique featuring African designers. While the venue is formally open to everyone, without any racial restrictions, its primary focus is undeniably on the African diaspora and those keen to explore its rich culture.

For three days, an unnatural darkness enveloped the land, chilling temperatures and disrupting life. When light returned, Cusco showed signs of upheaval, with temples misaligned and water channels reversed. context:
La chispa del amor cierra sus 10 episodios como miniserie en Netflix **La chispa del amor** (Take Charge of My Heart), con Kim Young-kwang y Chae Soo-bin, ya está completa en Netflix. Se estrenó el 9 de octubre de 2026 y la plataforma la presenta como **miniserie de 10 episodios**.

La historia adapta la novela web Charge Me Up, de Haebeon. Park Soo-won dirige y Song You-chae firma el guion, con producción de NEW POINT y WHYNOT MEDIA, según el anuncio oficial de Netflix. Su premisa combina un romance por contrato con una limitación fantástica que condiciona cada acercamiento entre los protagonistas.

Kim interpreta a Baek Ho-rang, un heredero empresarial cuyo corazón artificial necesita recargarse. Chae encarna a Na Bo-bae, una guionista que adquirió la capacidad de generar electricidad después de que un rayo la alcanzara en la infancia. Tocar a otra persona puede provocarle una descarga, de modo que el contacto físico complica su vida sentimental.

El avance oficial de Netflix explica el intercambio que los reúne: Ho-rang necesita su ayuda durante tres meses, hasta una nueva operación, y Bo-bae tiene el mismo plazo para terminar un guion romántico. Él ofrece cumplir sus deseos de

context:
Netflix anuncia acuerdo para transmitir el Mundial 2030 en exclusiva: Sólo en España El Mundial 2030 de la FIFA se jugará con sedes principales en España, Portugal y Marruecos, siendo el primero en la historia en tener una organización conjunta por países de dos diferentes continentes, sin contar los otros tres países que tendrán al menos un partido oficial en sus territorios, es decir, Argentina, Uruguay y Paraguay, en cuyo caso serían tres continentes.

Al final, después de todos estos aspectos que harán que los derechos de transmisión sean un tema a verse a futuro en la mayoría de los países, en el caso de España y Andorra, ya se han anunciado que, en exclusiva, han sido adquiridos por Netflix, siendo posibles ver los 104 partidos de la Copa del Mundo 2030 sólo por medio de la plataforma de streaming.

A plataforma ofrecerá a competición íntegra en directo e permitirá ver de balde un encontro de cada xornada en España, mentres que unha televisión nacional en aberto emitirá todos os partidos da selección…
context: Netflix emitirá en exclusiva os 104 partidos do Mundial de fútbol de 2030 en España e Andorra A plataforma ofrecerá a competición íntegra en directo e permitirá ver de balde un encontro de cada xornada en España, mentres que unha televisión nacional en aberto emitirá todos os partidos da selección española, as dúas semifinais e a final Netflix anunciou este martes a adquisición dos dereitos exclusivos para España e Andorra da Copa Mundial da FIFA 2030, unha competición da que ofrecerá en directo os 104 partidos. O acordo supón a entrada da plataforma de streaming nun dos principais escaparates do fútbol internacional, coincidindo coa edición que conmemorará o centenario do torneo e na que España será un dos países anfitrións.

context:
A question of conscience ### Tuesday 13th October 2026

It's been such a busy time lately. Ever since CityGate Church announced that the Odeon cinema would be closing and that they were about to apply for Change of Use Planning Permission to turn it into a Place of Worship there have been meetings upon meetings.

I am measuring my words carefully here. It's quite possible that, as one of the Ward Councillors, I might be called to speak if it comes to Committee and I cannot give anyone any hint of Predetermination. That said, I hope for the building to be kept open for use by the whole diversity of our community. I'm so happy that this issue has galvanised us, and I hope we can keep that community spirit going, whatever happens in the next few months or years.

The LibDem team all did videos over the weekend related to the questions we were going to ask in last night's Full Council and, though initially they filled me with horror, I think I've now got the vlogging bug. Mine seems to have been viewed 2.4K times, which is a surprise.

context:
Amigo de RJ Mitte de 'Breaking Bad' revela detalhes comoventes sobre os últimos dias do ator: "Ele estava sofrendo" 
Luis Moncada, conhecido por interpretar Marco Salamanca em Breaking Bad, compartilhou detalhes sobre os últimos dias de RJ Mitte, seu colega de elenco na série. Em uma entrevista ao programa TMZ Live, exibida na terça-feira, o ator relatou que percebeu o amigo abatido e emocionalmente fragilizado durante um reencontro, pouco mais de uma semana antes de sua morte. Segundo Moncada, os dois se encontraram inicialmente em um torneio beneficente de golfe. Depois, seguiram para um show de comédia ao lado de Steven Quezada, que também integrou o elenco da produção da AMC. Durante esses encontros, o ator notou que Mitte parecia diferente do habitual. Preocupado com o amigo, Moncada decidiu convidá-lo para participar do Festival Internacional de Balões de Albuquerque no dia seguinte, na tentativa de distraí-lo e proporcionar um momento mais leve. RJ Mitte e Luis Moncada Reprodução/TikTok Revistas Newsletter Ao recordar o reencontro, Moncada afirmou que percebeu sinais de sofrimento emocional em Mitte. O ator descreveu o colega como alguém que parecia estar enfrentando conflit

Yes, we're talking about Alejandro Iñárritu's satirical black comedy Digger, which stars Tom Cruise.



Kojima said Digger is a "film that all of us living in today's world should see."



He added: "It is a work that remains with the audience, provoking reflection and sounding alarms."



Kojima doesn't get into detailed specifics in his Digger review, and that's likely because, if you've seen the movie or know the plot, you wouldn't want to spoil the film for other people, either. 



In any event, Kojima said Digger and its message will stay with you for years to come. "As you absorb this film and carry it with you, a 'tool (a digger)' for delving deeper into the future will surely begin to take shape within you," he said.

November 2026, das Coming-of-Age-Drama „Hinter der Linie“. Zwei Tage später, am Sonntag, 22. November 2026, zeigt KiKA den Film um 20.15 Uhr.

Raya träumt von einer Karriere als Fußballprofi. Doch das Verhalten ihres Trainers verunsichert sie immer mehr und lässt sie spüren, dass etwas nicht stimmt. Während eines Trainingscamps erkennt Raya, dass auch ihre Mitspielerin Marie unter dem Verhalten von Trainer Lukas leidet.

Als Lukas Marie immer stärker unter Druck setzt, steht Raya vor einer Entscheidung: Schweigt sie weiter, oder steht sie für Marie und für sich selbst ein?

context:
‘Cameron Winter At Carnegie Hall’ Trailer: Paul Thomas Anderson Captures The Geese Frontman In An Intimate 35mm Concert Film Paul Thomas Anderson has spent much of his career making movies about complicated, often eccentric people, but his latest film strips things down considerably. No sprawling ensemble, no elaborate narrative, and no movie stars. Just a 23-year-old musician, a piano, and one of the most famous concert halls in the world. The first trailer for “Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall” offers a glimpse of Anderson’s intimate concert film, which premiered earlier this month at the New York Film Festival.

author: tiffanyleigh.northsky.social
text:
Systems & GM's & narrators who deploy what they call "cinematic language" such as exclaiming "establishing shot" or "cut to" or "zoom in on" is not framing it as cinema, but as screenplay direction. 

Which amounts to TTRPG Actual Play being more akin to a script table read or podcast transcript.

author: tiffanyleigh.northsky.social
text: I don't think TTRPG Actual Play can ever truly be "cinematic" or pure cinema, & that any comps or attempts to cinematic can be described as theatrical, or multi-media but not cinematic.

Festivalto 2026 si conclude a Fucecchio con tre giorni di cinema, musica e incontri

Si conclude a Fucecchio (Firenze) con un weekend di cinema, musica e incontri l’edizione 2026 di Festivalto, un progetto culturale itinerante che riesce a coinvolgere diverse generazioni e territori su tematiche…
context: Festivalto 2026 si conclude a Fucecchio con tre giorni di cinema, musica e incontri Si conclude a Fucecchio (Firenze) con un weekend di cinema, musica e incontri l’edizione 2026 di Festivalto, un progetto culturale itinerante che riesce a coinvolgere diverse generazioni e territori su tematiche quali ambiente, memoria storica e pensiero critico: il “festival che non c’è”, come recitava il claim della prima edizione. Tra gli eventi in programma, ci saranno i concerti di SCAR, Michiamanojack, The Funkin’ Machine, Montefiori Cocktail, oltre a una tavola rotonda dedicata ai cammini storici e alla memoria. Tutti gli eventi sono ad ingresso libero. Giovedì 15 ottobre alle ore 9, il Nuovo Teatro Pacini ospiterà, nell’ambito del progetto “I Luoghi della Memoria nel Cinema”, una proiezione dedicata alle scuole medie di Fucecchio e Cerreto Guidi del film “L’uomo che verrà”, diretto da Giorgio Diritti, che tratta la tragedia della strage di Marzabotto.

Jordan e Austin Butler nos papéis clássicos da dupla de detetives Ricardo Tubbs e Sonny Crockett. O filme será um reboot da popular série de TV dos anos 80, que originalmente tinha Philip Michael Thomas como Tubbs, e Don Johnson como Crockett.

Abaixo, nos pôsteres publicados pelo estúdio, aparecem Jordan como o detetive Ricardo “Rico” Tubbs e Butler como o detetive James “Sonny” Crockett.
